title: Refundable Deposits: How to Restore Cooperation in Finitely Repeated Games
abstract: arXiv:2608.27536v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While infinitely repeated games admit a rich set of Nash equilibria, finitely repeated games typically have a much smaller and often inefficient one. We show how to enlarge this set using deposits: in each period a player may place a refundable sum with a neutral intermediary, returned when the game ends and forfeited following a deviation. Paying these deposits is voluntary and incentive compatible at every stage, so no commitment by the players is assumed, the only commitment required being that of the intermediary to a refund rule fixed before play begins. The mechanism sustains payoff profiles more efficient than those of the standard equilibria, without altering the underlying game and without transfers between players. We demonstrate it on the prisoner's dilemma, a congestion game, and a public goods game, all settings where cooperation cannot emerge in the standard finitely repeated version. translated_title: 可退还押金：如何在有限重复博弈中恢复合作
translated_abstract: 虽然无限重复博弈拥有丰富的纳什均衡集合，但有限重复博弈通常只有一个小得多的均衡集合，且往往是无效率的。我们展示了如何通过押金来扩大这一集合：在每一期，参与者可以将一笔可退还的款项存入一个中立的中介机构，该款项在博弈结束时退还，若出现偏离行为则被没收。支付这些押金是自愿的，并且在每个阶段都满足激励相容，因此不需要假设参与者作出任何承诺，唯一需要的承诺是中介机构对博弈开始前即已确定的退款规则的承诺。该机制能够维持比标准均衡更有效率的收益组合，而无需改变底层博弈，也无需参与者之间的转移支付。我们在囚徒困境、拥挤博弈和公共品博弈中演示了该机制，这些都是标准有限重复版本中无法出现合作的情形。我们还将该机制应用于动态公共资源博弈。
tldr: 该论文提出一种由中立中介执行的可退还押金机制，在自愿参与、激励相容且无需参与者承诺或转移支付的条件下，扩大有限重复博弈的均衡集合，使囚徒困境等博弈中原本无法出现的合作得以恢复并实现更有效率的收益。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a refundable deposit mechanism enforced by a neutral intermediary, which voluntarily and incentive-compatibly enlarges the equilibrium set of finitely repeated games—restoring cooperation in settings like the prisoner's dilemma and sustaining more efficient payoffs without altering the game, requiring player commitment, or using transfers.
